svg.aria-label: Web3 solutions: dApps, smart contracts, wallet integrations, exchange APIs and on-chain analytics, built around crypto. Android and web apps with Flutter, React Native, Capacitor, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Node.js. Market tooling: bots and monitors for Indian and UK stocks and crypto, with every decision logged. AI products: LLM agents, RAG chatbots, real-time assistants, text-to-SQL and automation on Claude, OpenAI and open models. Custom business solutions: websites, stores, dashboards and internal tools built around how each business works.
